mapper.insert: insert into stock_watchlist_analysis_snapshot (user_id, watchlist_id, analysis_json, analyzed_at, create_time, update_time) select #{userId}, #{watchlistId}, #{analysisJson}, #{analyzedAt}, sysdate(), sysdate() from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId} and watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} lock in share mode on duplicate key update analysis_json = #{analysisJson}, analyzed_at = #{analyzedAt}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.delete: delete from stock_watchlist_analysis_snapshot where user_id = #{userId} and watchlist_id = #{watchlistId}
